name: Congee (Jook / Savory Chicken & Egg Rice Porridge)
whyItWorks: White rice simmered in chicken bone broth until it completely breaks down into a thick, velvety savory porridge.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer 1 part white jasmine rice in 7 parts chicken bone broth with ginger powder. Top with finely shredded chicken, soft-boiled egg, and soy sauce.
